pages.label: Home
pages.notes: Replace path with the exact Home page URL. Capture dashboard widgets or summary settings that may be useful later.

pages.label: Monitoring
pages.notes: Replace path with the Monitoring page URL. Capture live status views or operational controls if they affect future setup.

pages.label: Manage
pages.notes: Usually the highest-priority rebuild area. Capture all event, queue, waiting room, redirect, and branding forms under Manage.

pages.label: Integration
pages.notes: Capture API, tag, script, webhook, connector, or embed settings.

pages.label: Traffic Access Rules
pages.notes: Capture allow lists, bypass rules, prioritization rules, IP rules, token rules, and any rule conditions.

pages.label: Traffic Insights
pages.notes: Capture if needed for operational reference, but this is often lower rebuild priority than Manage or Integration.

pages.label: Statistics
pages.notes: Usually reporting-focused. Capture only if your team needs historical evidence or setup-linked reporting views.

pages.label: Account
pages.notes: Capture account-level settings, tenant info, users, permissions, branding defaults, and related configuration.
